mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment ( payment_id, reservation_id, payment_key, order_id, created_at, paid_at, amount, payment_method, status ) VALUES ( #{paymentId}, #{reservationId}, #{paymentKey}, #{orderId}, NOW(), NULL, #{amount}, #{method}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.payment_id AS paymentId, p.reservation_id AS reservationId, r.user_id AS userId, p.payment_key AS paymentKey, p.order_id AS orderId, p.amount AS amount, p.payment_method AS method, p.status AS status, p.paid_at AS paidAt, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM payment p JOIN reservation r ON p.reservation_id = r.reservation_id WHERE p.payment_id = #{paymentId}

SELECT p.payment_id AS paymentId, p.reservation_id AS reservationId, r.user_id AS userId, p.payment_key AS paymentKey, p.order_id AS orderId, p.amount AS amount, p.payment_method AS method, p.status AS status, p.paid_at AS paidAt, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM payment p JOIN reservation r ON p.reservation_id = r.reservation_id WHERE p.payment_id = #{paymentId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT payment_id AS paymentId, reservation_id AS reservationId, payment_key AS paymentKey, order_id AS orderId, amount AS amount, payment_method AS method, status AS status, paid_at AS paidAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM payment WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT p.payment_id AS paymentId, p.reservation_id AS reservationId, r.user_id AS userId, p.payment_key AS paymentKey, p.order_id AS orderId, p.amount AS amount, p.payment_method AS method, p.status AS status, p.paid_at AS paidAt, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM payment p JOIN reservation r ON p.reservation_id = r.reservation_id WHERE p.reservation_id = #{reservationId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.payment_id AS paymentId, p.reservation_id AS reservationId, p.payment_key AS paymentKey, p.order_id AS orderId, p.amount AS amount, p.payment_method AS method, p.status AS status, p.paid_at AS paidAt, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM payment p JOIN reservation r ON p.reservation_id = r.reservation_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET status = #{status}, payment_method = #{method}, payment_key = #{paymentKey}, paid_at = NOW() WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId}
mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT( SUBSTRING(u.email, 1, 3), '***@', SUBSTRING_INDEX(u.email, '@', -1) ) AS maskedEmail, CONCAT( SUBSTRING(COALESCE(up.kr_last_name, up.last_name, '고'), 1, 1), '**' ) AS passengerName, COALESCE(rs.snap_departure_airport, 'ICN') AS departureAirport, COALESCE(rs.snap_arrival_airport, 'NRT') AS arrivalAirport, p.amount AS amount, p.paid_at AS paidAt FROM payment p INNER JOIN reservation r ON p.reservation_id = r.reservation_id INNER JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON u.user_id = up.user_id LEFT JOIN reservation_segment rs ON r.reservation_id = rs.reservation_id AND rs.segment_order = 1 WHERE p.status = 'PAID' AND p.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND p.paid_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) ORDER BY p.paid_at DESC LIMIT 10
